name: Savino Giannetta
bioAdditions: Sam came over from Italy with his mother about 1909 and was working at a coal breaker by 1920 (S1, S2). His wife was Mamie (Dominica Maria) Bocchicchio, named 'Mamie ... Bocchio' as the mother of their daughter Angelica A. Genett on Angelica's 1947 marriage license. Angelica married Irving J. Weibel at Dunmore on 19 Apr 1947 (S3).
